programme.desc: Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man is forced to leave home and work to support his family by teaching martial arts skills for self-defense.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A destitute young man arrives in the city and begins working with his late father's friend, who manages a workshop and is a retired kung fu artist.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: A Vietnam vet who's now an 'honourable' mercenary-for-hire taking on an assignment tracking down an assassin who's fled to Cambodia after murdering an industrialist from Hong Kong.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: Kung-fu master 'Liu Chia Liang', lent his superior expertise when playing the director's role in Heroes Of The East.

programme.title: Widow Warriors
programme.desc: When the men in a triad family are betrayed and gunned down by a rival gang, their wives decide to take revenge for the death of their husbands.

programme.title: The Tigers
programme.desc: Five cops find their careers and their lives in jeopardy when they accept a 10 million dollar bribe from a drug smuggler, to release him from custody during a drug bust.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Manchu Emperor employs some top boxers to destroy Shaolin Temple. Almost all the Shaolin disciples were killed, but the survivors now band together to seek revenge.

programme.title: Return To The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: Workers of a factory have their pay cut. Desperate for their full wages, they hire an actor to impersonate a priest and kung-fu expert from the temple of Shaolin.

programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: Yu Xiang and Tong Tong move into a new neighbourhood where everyone's life seems perfect. Dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really is as it seems.

programme.title: Eye for an Eye 2
programme.desc: Blind blade master Cheng Xia Zi saves massacre survivor Zhang Xiao Yu and takes her in. As he trains her, she waits for the chance to avenge her family.

programme.title: Relentless Fury
